Only takes effect with `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.gc-enabled`; the periodic retention log sample also uses it. Must not be negative (startup refusal when tool publication is enabled). A bare number is seconds. |
| `enabled` | `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_TOOL_PUBLICATION_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | Whether the server accepts tool output publication: Hosted Shell executions stream their output through the internal `/internal/managed-tool-publications` API into object storage (Aliyun OSS unless a custom store bean is registered). Startup is refused unless this group's service URL, capacities and deadlines are set, plus the OSS endpoint, region and bucket. Off a loopback address it also requires `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding-key`, unless `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` is true. |
| `entry-concurrency` | — | integer | — | How many tool publication API requests this server process handles at once; a request beyond that gets HTTP 429 `managed_tool_publication_busy`. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be at least 1 (startup refusal). |
| `execution-bytes` | — | integer | — | How many bytes of output one tool execution may capture; it is also sent to the Harness as the capture limit for Shell and team-lead executions. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be between 1 byte and 2 TiB (2^41 bytes). Startup is refused if verifying that much output would exceed `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.max-verification-timeout`. |
| `gc-enabled` | `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_TOOL_PUBLICATION_GC_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | Whether the server garbage-collects retired tool output: capture objects in object storage and the stored resources of retired Sessions, once `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.deletion-grace` has passed. Only read when `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enabled` is true. |
| `max-verification-timeout` | — | duration | — | The longest deadline a publication verification may get. Must be positive and at most 25 minutes; startup is refused if `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.operation-timeout` plus the time to verify `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.execution-bytes` (and a fixed producer allowance) at `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.verification-bytes-per-second` exceeds it. Required when tool publication is enabled. A bare number is seconds. |
| `operation-timeout` | — | duration | — | How long a publication operation (upload, verification or finish) may run before its deadline; verifying stored content adds one second per `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.verification-bytes-per-second` bytes. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be positive and longer than `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.claim-timeout` (startup refusal). A bare number is seconds. |
| `oss-bucket` | — | string | *(empty)* | The Aliyun OSS bucket that stores tool output objects. Required when tool publication is enabled with the default OSS store (startup refusal); ignored when a custom `ToolPublicationObjectStore` bean is registered. |
| `oss-endpoint` | — | string | *(empty)* | The Aliyun OSS endpoint for tool output objects. Must be `https://oss-<region>.aliyuncs.com` for `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-region`, with no path, query or user info (startup refusal otherwise). OSS credentials are secrets read from the `OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET` environment variables (plus `OSS_SESSION_TOKEN` for a temporary token). Required with the default OSS store; ignored when a custom store bean is registered. |
| `oss-region` | — | string | *(empty)* | The Aliyun OSS region (for example `cn-hangzhou`) used for V4 request signing; it must match the `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-endpoint` host. Required with the default OSS store (startup refusal); ignored when a custom store bean is registered. |
| `service-base-url` | — | string | *(empty)* | The base URL that Runtimes use to reach this server's tool publication API; they resolve `/internal/managed-tool-publications` against it. Must be an absolute `http` or `https` URL without path, query or fragment; plaintext `http` to a non-loopback host is refused unless `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` is true. Required when tool publication is enabled. With SSH Runtime nodes configured it must be an `http` URL. |
| `session-bytes` | — | integer | — | How many bytes of tool output one Session may hold reserved across its captures; each reservation counts its capture size plus a fixed overhead of 4784128 bytes. A reservation that would exceed it is refused. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be at least 1 (startup refusal). |
| `tenant-bytes` | — | integer | — | How many bytes of tool output one tenant may hold reserved across all its Sessions' captures; each reservation counts its capture size plus a fixed overhead of 4784128 bytes. A reservation that would exceed it is refused. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be at least 1 (startup refusal). |
| `verification-bytes-per-second` | — | integer | — | The verification throughput floor in bytes per second: a verification deadline is `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.operation-timeout` plus one second for each this many bytes being verified, and must stay within `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.max-verification-timeout`. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be at least 1 (startup refusal). |
| `verification-concurrency` | `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_TOOL_PUBLICATION_VERIFICATION_CONCURRENCY` | integer | `2` | How many background threads verify asynchronously admitted publication operations. The verifier keeps running when `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.async-verification-enabled` is turned off, so accepted operations drain. Must be at least 1 (startup refusal when tool publication is enabled). |
